UPDATE image_version SET current = TRUE
            WHERE version = (
                SELECT next.version
                FROM image_version curr
                JOIN image_version next
                    ON next.image_id = curr.image_id
                WHERE curr.image_id = $1
                    AND curr.version = $2
                    AND next.ts > curr.ts
                ORDER BY next.ts ASC LIMIT 1
            )
            RETURNING version
